name: News / Reporting
description: Attribution-first reporting with chronology and explicit uncertainty.

stages.story: Separate verified facts, attributed claims, context and unresolved uncertainty; do not speculate.
stages.scene_direction: Prioritize chronology, source context, neutral framing and clear location/time transitions.
stages.image: Use evidentiary frames and restrained graphics; label reconstructions and illustrative material.
stages.audio: Keep narration precise and intelligible; use restrained ambience and never imply certainty through dramatic sound.
stages.video: Use motivated, factual motion and preserve source context; avoid misleading edits.
stages.review: Check attribution, chronology, uncertainty labels, source provenance and misleading juxtaposition.
